A correlator finds the frame: Barker-13 in a stream of chips

Slide a Barker-13 preamble through a stream of chips and watch the correlator peak at 13 where it lines up. Flip chips to add noise; see when the lock fails.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/fpga/bpsk.t27 (t27 master): every value on the page is its fn bodies, compiled to wasm (logic.js)
  • R. H. Barker, Group synchronizing of binary digital systems, in Communication Theory, Butterworth, 1953: the length-13 code and its sidelobes of at most 1
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/fpga/bpsk.t27: the ZeroDSP BPSK modem core, BARKER13_BITS, correlate, rx_push, SYNC_THRESHOLD 9
